label: Root wiring of disconnected Causality results
summary: Root wiring of disconnected Causality results (map explorations/causality-root-wiring.toml, spec specs/causality-root-wiring.toml). Eight derivations make verified conclusions that no designated-route argument consumed into premises of arguments concluding designated-route statements: the owner-approved floor STMT-CAUSAL-POWER-AND-ACTIVITY-REQUIRE-CONCRETENESS replaces its open halves in the two Round 4 Cogito derivations (composing inhabitedFromProduction and inhabitedFromPower), and five rival-refutation conclusions plus the Cogito retorsion yield the principles their rivals denied (excluded middle where needed; the Scotist case is constructive). Nine previously disconnected results now reach the root; the two NECESSARY-CLASSICAL-GOD-CASE route costs drop by one (STMT-CAUSERS-REQUIRE-CONCRETENESS-AT leaves them). Stated route premises stay single leaves: no route premise other than that one is established.
